The '''Adjudicators''' were the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] that governed the actions of the outsiders on [[Voss]]. There used to be no need for special law enforcements as all Voss obeyed the [[Three]], but the arrival of many Republic and Imperial individuals to Voss made the Adjudicators work a necessity.<ref name="SWTOR" />
